outputs.rationale: Dataset and canonical scientific model identities must match exactly.
Every complete row, repeat, fold, assignment version, and digest must match exactly.
Requested, completed, failed, and typed failure identities must match exactly.
SSE, absolute error, RMSE, MAE, benchmark, and Q-squared-predict must agree in stable target order.
Target identities, observation counts, unavailable values, and lower-RMSE/MAE labels are exact typed state.
Established, alternative, and signed fold losses must agree after exact fold identity is established.
Repeat, fold, and exact test source-row identities must match.
Per-case repeated mean losses and signed differences must agree in source-row order.
Source-row identity and repeat count must match exactly.
CVPAT moments, probabilities, t statistic, and interval must agree after the exact case-loss ledger matches.
Direction, degrees of freedom, lower-loss model, unavailable status, reason, and decision are categorical outputs.
Equation SSE, BIC, and BIC deltas must agree without an epsilon floor.
Construct identity, sample size, parameter counts, and preferred candidate must match exactly.
Two weights must agree and sum to one per equation.
Candidate order, equation identity, and availability status must match exactly.

estimands.definition: The two scientific model identities, immutable data identity, union complete-case set, deterministic shared-fold assignment, and exact pair accounting used by every downstream comparison.
estimands.label: Exact common prediction-task identity
estimands.unit: typed identities, row/fold ledger, digest, and integer counts

estimands.definition: Actual common-holdout indicator errors, indicator-average benchmark, Q-squared-predict values, fold losses, and case losses after both models are fully refit on every exact shared training partition.
estimands.label: Two-candidate PLSpredict outcome comparison
estimands.unit: raw indicator units, squared indicator units, dimensionless Q-squared, and typed ledgers

estimands.definition: Alternative-minus-established repeated case-loss mean, sample variance, standard error, t statistic, N minus one degrees of freedom, directional and two-sided probabilities, and interval.
estimands.label: Paired model CVPAT
estimands.unit: mean squared prediction loss, probability, t scale, and decision

estimands.definition: For each common endogenous structural equation, N log(SSE divided by N) plus p log(N), where p is incoming predictors plus one; no generic or whole-model BIC is substituted.
estimands.label: Prediction-oriented equation BIC

estimands.definition: Within each common endogenous equation, normalized exp of minus one-half BIC delta for exactly two candidates.
estimands.label: Two-candidate BIC-derived Akaike weights
estimands.unit: delta BIC and unit-sum model weight

model_predicates.expression: Exactly two schema-v3 point-estimate PLS algorithm recipes have different canonical scientific model digests after names, UUIDs, and declaration order are removed.
Both candidates expose the exact same nonempty reflective endogenous construct IDs and indicator sets.
Both candidates are recursive and omit observed controls, higher-order constructs, interactions, formative endogenous targets, case weights, PLSc, and resampling recipes.
Weighting, preprocessing, missing-data policy, convergence tolerance, and maximum iterations match exactly between candidates.

preprocessing.operation: Bind exactly two preregistered point-estimate PLS recipes to one immutable raw-data fingerprint and a persisted established-minus-alternative direction.
Require distinct scientific model digests, identical supported settings, and identical nonempty reflective endogenous target IDs and indicators.
Resolve numeric indicators across the union of both models and apply one finite listwise pool before any fold assignment.
For each repetition rank source rows by SHA-256 over the version, seed, repetition, and source row, then allocate round-robin and persist the complete ledger and digest.
Fit both actual PLS models on each exact shared training partition and retain any typed pair failure without substituting saved-run results.
Apply training transforms, outer weights, recursive structural coefficients, and training indicator regressions to the identical holdout rows for both candidates.
Aggregate indicator SSE, RMSE, MAE, indicator-average benchmark, Q-squared-predict, fold losses, and per-case repeated mean squared losses.

Compute alternative-minus-established case-loss differences, sample variance with N minus one, t statistic, lower-tail directional probability, two-sided probability, and interval; zero variance is explicitly unavailable.
Fit both candidates on the same complete pool and compute each common endogenous structural-score equation SSE and predictor count plus intercept.
Calculate equation-level BIC as N log(SSE divided by N) plus p log(N), then normalize exp of minus one-half BIC delta across exactly two candidates.
Assemble method versions, dataset and scientific-model identities, ledgers, warnings, Internal/Labs surface, and qualified false without committing a partial result.
